sermon.title: How to obtain eternal life?
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer asks how we enter the kingdom of God. Not all who say Lord, Lord will enter, and miracles alone don’t prove approval. We must be born again of the Spirit and the word, become as little children, and bring forth fruit worthy of repentance, since all will be judged by their works. The service closes in surrender and song.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear.

faqs.question: Do we have to go overseas to reach the nations?
faqs.answer: No. The people around us are the nations.

scriptures.text_nkjv: Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works and glorify your Father in heaven.
And Jesus said to them, “I am the bread of life. He who comes to Me shall never hunger, and he who believes in Me shall never thirst.

faqs.question: Is there a step after the blood?
faqs.answer: Bring forth fruit worthy of repentance; if we don’t live right, that blood doesn’t do us any good.
